definitions.approved: A knife the user currently considers worthy of further research into acquisition. This is not a final purchase decision.
definitions.rejected: A knife the user considers banned, unworthy, or not worth further research into purchase.
definitions.clean: A knife that is more than beautiful while utilizing minimal aesthetics.
definitions.fancy: A unique blade style not often seen, e.g. Spyderco Matriarch 2 Emerson.
definitions.tiered: An enthusiast knife in the high-tier quality range of, or above, a Chris Reeve.

canadian_online_retailer_rule.rule: If a folding knife is listed by a Canadian online retailer, treat it as valid for Canadian acquisition research unless the listing itself clearly identifies a prohibited mechanism.
do_not_flag_as_conditional_just_because: button lock used only as a lock
only_reject_or_fail_if_clear_prohibited_: button/spring/device in handle that automatically opens the blade
